title: 9-Day Cappadocia, Petra & Wadi Rum Adventure
metaDescription: Journey from Istanbul and Cappadocia to Petra and Wadi Rum in 9 days, combining volcanic landscapes, ancient wonders and Jordan's dramatic desert.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 9-Day Best of Turkey & Jordan Tour connects Istanbul and Cappadocia with Jordan’s most important historical and desert destinations. Begin in Istanbul before flying to Cappadocia, then continue to Amman for the Jordanian portion. Explore Petra before spending a night in a desert camp at Wadi Rum, followed by time at the Dead Sea. The route keeps Turkey focused on its cultural highlights while Jordan adds archaeological sites and desert landscapes.
The escorted program includes selected 4-star hotels, one night in a desert camp, breakfast, guided sightseeing, entrance fees, airport transfers, three domestic flights and private transportation throughout Jordan.

itinerary.title: Arrival to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise - Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. Transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour - Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. Transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul (19:30–21:00). Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Amman By Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Istanbul. Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Amman.
Upon arrival at Queen Alia International Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. Free time at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Madaba – Mt. Nebo – Dead Sea – Petra
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Amman. Drive to Madaba and visit St. George’s Church, home to the famous mosaic map of the Holy Land. Continue to Mount Nebo for panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Holy Land. Proceed to the Dead Sea for free time and the unique floating experience before continuing to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Visit Petra then to Amman
itinerary.text: Visit Petra, the famous Rose Red City of the Nabataean civilization. Walk through the narrow Siq to the iconic Al-Khazneh (Treasury), then continue to the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. After the tour, drive back to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Amman Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Amman
Check-out and transfer to Queen Alia International Airport for your return flight home

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 9-Day Turkey & Jordan Holiday?
faqs.a: The 9-Day Turkey & Jordan Holiday covers Istanbul and Pamukkale in Turkey, along with Amman and Petra in Jordan. This itinerary combines vibrant cities, ancient civilizations, natural wonders, and world-famous archaeological sites, offering an unforgettable journey through two fascinating countries. The tour runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-Day Turkey & Jordan Holiday cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,095 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and three domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, three domestic flights are included within the itinerary. These flights help maximize sightseeing time and provide convenient travel between destinations. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are selected for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Turkey and Jordan. Your guides will provide expert insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a balanced introduction to both countries. It combines major historical landmarks, cultural attractions, and unique natural wonders into one memorable itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historical districts, and uneven terrain. Petra involves a considerable amount of walking, while most other sightseeing activities are suitable for visitors with average fitness levels.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and Bosphorus in Istanbul; the spectacular white travertine terraces of Pamukkale; the historic and modern attractions of Amman; and the extraordinary UNESCO World Heritage Site of Petra, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 9-Day Turkey & Jordan Holiday?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 9-Day Turkey & Jordan Holiday be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Cappadocia, Wadi Rum, the Dead Sea, Jerash, or Aqaba, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
